proposition.claim:
Recorded check: False effective square saturation caused by dropping primitivity

x=2,y=25 positive coprime; y=1 mod4; Kronecker(2,25)=1; no numerator congruence/reciprocity restriction in Table1. n=441=21^2>=400=8xy.

Recorded check: Parabolic maps invalidate essential uniform contraction and distortion arguments

W={L,R^4} is a finite subset of Psi. Its first-level closed images [1/2,1] and[0,1/5] are disjoint. L andR^4 persist in sufficiently large prefix-reduced construction families.

Recorded check: Corollary2.21 proof wrongly enlarges Psi2 to Psi

k=3>=0 gives positive coprime start(3,11). L³=(1,3;0,1) has determinant1, is nonnegative and has Kronecker(1,3)=1; henceL³ inPsi.

Recorded check: Released denominator branch skips valid progression terms

Inputx1,y5,n25,entry2 is nonnegative and primitive. Only mathematical intended control flow is evaluated; no author binary compiled or executed. Both snapshots' semigroup.c bytes match.

Recorded check: Corollary2.17 orbit equality includes inadmissible finite endpoints

L4,R4 are nonidentity members ofPsi2. All continued fractions use positive multiples of4 afterleading0 and hence have denominator>=4.
